title: SKF_BRIEF_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-brief-skill prints when {headless_mode} is true or the run is in [auto] mode, at the end of a successful run and at every HARD HALT, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_BRIEF_RESULT_JSON: '. Pipelines grep one line out of the workflow log to branch on the brief outcome without parsing prose. Schema mirrors the contract in src/skf-brief-skill/references/invocation-contract.md (Result Contract).

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the wrapper, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' once the run has written the brief (step 5) or, in [auto] mode, the user or a headless run approved it (step 1b). 'error' on any HARD HALT.

brief_path.description: Absolute path to the written skill-brief.yaml on success. Null when the run errored before any file was written (or when overwrite-cancelled aborted before write).

skill_name.description: Brief's skill_name field, present in every envelope (success and error): the literal 'unknown' on a halt that fires before step 1 resolves the name.

version.description: Resolved brief version (target_version if set, else auto-detected, else '1.0.0'). Null when the run errored before step 5's version-resolution ran.

language.description: Detected or user-confirmed primary language. Null when the run errored before step 2's language-detection ran.

scope_type.description: Confirmed scope.type from step 3. Null when the run errored before scope was confirmed.

exit_code.description: Process exit code matching the Exit Codes table in src/skf-brief-skill/references/invocation-contract.md. Derived deterministically from halt_reason: null→0, input-missing/input-invalid→2, forge-tier-missing/target-inaccessible/gh-auth-failed→3, write-failed→4, overwrite-cancelled→5, user-cancelled→6.

halt_reason.description: Null on success. One of the documented HALT classes on error. Pipelines branch on this to surface the right operator message without grepping the prose error.

mode.description: 'auto' when BS was invoked with the [auto] bracket modifier (pipeline auto-brief generation). Null otherwise (interactive or headless-without-auto).

warnings.description: Optional. Non-fatal anomalies surfaced during the run, one string each, such as customization_resolver_unavailable when the customization resolver could not apply the _bmad/custom/ overrides. Present only when the run recorded at least one, so an envelope without warnings is unchanged.
